title: Chapter 418 Master Bronze Hammer'S Request
content:
Chapter 418 Master Bronze Hammer'S Request

Wang Shuo was shocked and broke out in a cold sweat when he heard this.

"Thank you for your advice, Master."

"You are a teachable child. I have only one request to make exclusive equipment for you. Of course, you can refuse it."

"Please be clear, Master." Wang Shuo bowed his hands.

To get this set of Shura suit, Wang Shuo didn't know what the other party spent, but it was definitely not easy to do.

"So far, I have made exclusive equipment for five Shuras, but unfortunately, two of them have fallen."

"In this world today, no one can stay out. People like you are destined to shine on the continent. I just hope that one day in the future, if the Sky City of my Tianshuang Empire is in trouble, you can lend a hand."

Without waiting for Wang Shuo to speak, Master Tongchui said: "The empire has its own destiny. If it is destroyed, it will be destroyed, but my descendants hope to be taken care of by you."

Wang Shuo looked at Master Tongchui and couldn't calm down for a long time.

I am still a small county governor, and I can't accept it for a while. How can I be qualified to protect the descendants of an empire?

"Master Tongchui, what is the relationship between you and the Tianshuang Empire?"

"Hey, my real name is Ye Xiaofei, and I am a member of the royal family of the Tianshuang Empire. I asked Master Tianji to tell me before. The fate of the Tianshuang Empire has come to an end. I am powerless to change it. I can only make more good connections and leave a way for future generations to survive!"

Wang Shuo looked at Master Tongchui, as if he saw an old man who was explaining his affairs.

People are subject to misfortunes at any time, and no one knows what the future will be like.

Wang Shuo also felt the same way!

"Master, if I have the ability to protect your descendants in the future, I will definitely do it!"

"Okay, your words are enough!"

Master Tongchui stayed in Dahuai for a few more days, and Wang Shuo accompanied him to investigate the situation here.

"This place should be the site of the original Black Dragon City in the North Sea Empire. Time flies, and a thousand years have passed!" Wang Shuo's eyes widened, revealing an incredible expression. Master Tongchui looked at Wang Shuo's appearance, shook his head and laughed: "I haven't lived that long!" "It is said that there is a treasure of the North Sea Empire left in Black Dragon City. I don't know if it is true!" "If it is true, the Black Dragon King would have opened it long ago, and it would not have been left until now." Wang Shuo laughed and just thought it was a legend. At this time, Wang Shuo suddenly thought of something. "Master Tongchui, your family name is Ye. I wonder if you have heard of a person named Ye Xueer?" Master Tongchui pondered for a while and replied: "I do have a great-granddaughter named Ye Xueer, but we are tens of thousands of kilometers apart. How do you know her?" Wang Shuo's heart thumped when he heard it. He didn't know whether it was the same person, so he had to find an excuse and change the subject. "Master Tongchui, I want to ask you how to activate the red pupil state?"

Wang Shuo had tried it, but he didn't find out how to activate the red pupil state.

Master Tongchui frowned. He was not a Shura warrior and didn't know more about it.

"You might as well try it in actual combat to see if you can find a way to activate it!"

"Okay, I can only give it a try."

After staying for a few days, Master Tongchui left.

Before leaving, he took Matar with him and agreed to let him be a registered disciple.

Wang Shuo naturally agreed. Matar and Wang Shuo were only in an employment relationship. Although it was not a full year, the two sides got along well.
